name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 33" Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation with Retractable Faucet and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: Elevate your kitchen experience with the MultiSINK Kit an innovative, IAPMO-certified, dual mount workstation sink with three functional levels for seamless prep, wash, and dry. Custom-fit accessories adapt to your workflow, while the integrated pivoting WaterWALL delivers a sweeping rinse controlled directly from the faucet. A built-in spinning Glass Washer ensures spotless drinkware, and space-saving Drying Stations keep your counters clutter-free. The premium stainless steel faucet features four functions, including Boost Blade for tough messes, aerated flow, spray rinse, and waterfall activation. Includes upgraded chopping board, colander, roll-up grids, and modern strainer. Dual mount design allows for top-mount or undermount installation.
